item.title: Version 2.3.3
item.description: New in 2.3.3: the Records Wall keeps a per-animal ledger (PREDATORS FELLED - lifetime kills by kind, bosses included). The field is fair now: no one can leave the arena or pass through rocks, trees, crates, barrels or canyon walls. Barrels take five hits to pop and explode with real radial falloff - dangerous up close. Bullets sweep their whole path, so shots can no longer pass through targets at low frame rates. Records and XP bank exactly once however a run ends - death, retry, menu or closing the app.
